accounts.name: Operating Checking

accounts.description: Processor receipts awaiting settlement to the bank.

accounts.description: Amounts due from customers; review as the company's receivable control account.

accounts.name: Inventory
accounts.description: Merchandise held for sale.

accounts.description: Payments benefiting future periods.

accounts.name: Store and Warehouse Equipment
accounts.description: Capitalized store, warehouse, and fulfillment equipment.

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
accounts.description: Contra-asset for accumulated depreciation.

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.description: Amounts owed to vendors; review as the company's payable control account.

accounts.name: Business Credit Card
accounts.description: Primary business credit-card liability.

accounts.name: Sales Tax Payable
accounts.description: Sales tax collected and awaiting remittance.

accounts.name: Gift Cards and Customer Credits
accounts.description: Unredeemed gift cards and customer credits.

accounts.name: Loans Payable
accounts.description: Outstanding loan principal.

accounts.name: Owner Capital
accounts.description: Owner contributions and permanent capital.

accounts.name: Retained Earnings
accounts.description: Cumulative retained earnings.

accounts.name: Owner Draws and Distributions
accounts.description: Owner withdrawals and distributions.

accounts.name: Product Sales
accounts.description: Gross merchandise sales before returns and discounts.

accounts.name: Shipping Income
accounts.description: Shipping and handling charged to customers.

accounts.name: Sales Returns and Discounts
accounts.description: Contra-revenue for returns, allowances, and discounts.

accounts.name: Cost of Goods Sold
accounts.description: Cost assigned to merchandise sold.

accounts.name: Inbound Freight and Duties

accounts.name: Inventory Shrinkage

accounts.name: Merchant Processing Fees
accounts.description: Card and marketplace processing fees.

accounts.name: Advertising and Promotion
accounts.description: Paid media, promotions, and marketing campaigns.

accounts.name: Payroll Expense
accounts.description: Employee wages and employer payroll costs.

accounts.name: Rent and Occupancy
accounts.description: Store, office, and warehouse occupancy costs.

accounts.name: Packaging and Fulfillment
accounts.description: Packaging materials and fulfillment services not included in inventory cost.

accounts.name: Outbound Shipping Expense
accounts.description: Customer delivery costs not included in product cost.

accounts.name: Software and Marketplace Fees
accounts.description: Commerce software, marketplace, and platform fees.

accounts.name: Insurance Expense
accounts.description: Business insurance expense.

accounts.name: Professional Fees
